description: FULL BODY, head to toe. A 35-year-old Malaysian man with a short, neat military-style haircut. He is wearing a crisp, formal Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) dark blue uniform with silver badges and shoulder rank insignia. He stands with a professional and authoritative posture, wearing polished black leather shoes.

FULL BODY, head to toe. A middle-aged Malaysian man in his late 40s. He has a worried expression and slightly messy short black hair. He is wearing a casual, everyday outfit consisting of a plain light-colored polo shirt, dark grey trousers, and brown leather sandals.

FULL BODY, head to toe. A featureless human-shaped silhouette made of glowing circuit patterns. The figure is wearing a semi-transparent, holographic business suit to represent the fake professional persona. The entire form glows with a subtle, predatory digital violet light.

FULL BODY, head to toe. An anonymous, featureless android-like figure with a smooth, metallic silver surface. The figure is styled with the outline of a formal blazer and tie etched into its metallic surface, representing a fake official. It has glowing red optics instead of eyes.
